crossRefs.note: David said in his heart, “I will now perish one day by the hand of Saul. There is nothing better for me than that I…
When he saw that, he arose, and ran for his life, and came to Beersheba, which belongs to Judah, and left his servant…
When Jehoiakim the king, with all his mighty men and all the princes heard his words, the king sought to put him to…
David arose, and passed over, he and the six hundred men who were with him, to Achish the son of Maoch, king of Gath.
I will bless Yahweh at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

people.name: Achish

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gath

people.name: Saul

translations.web: David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
translations.bsb: That day David fled from Saul and went to Achish king of Gath.
translations.kjv: And David arose, and fled that day for fear of Saul, and went to Achish the king of Gath.
